tour.windowTitle: How to use the Design tab

mode.title: Pick what you're building
mode.body: PAGE designs a full web page or app screen; ANIMATE builds a motion graphic. In ANIMATE you also pick the renderer — Remotion (React, real MP4 export) or HyperFrames (HTML + GSAP timeline). Sessions remember their mode: reopening an old design flips these toggles back for you.

composer.title: Describe it
composer.body: Type what you want in plain words — attach files, a whole folder, or a reference image as context. With Interview on, the first turn asks a few smart questions before building anything; switch it off to build immediately. Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends.

brand.title: Design in a brand
brand.body: Paste a site URL here — its real palette, fonts and copy are extracted into a context chip the generator reads. Even easier: drop a URL straight into your prompt and the brand is pulled in automatically.

export.title: Preview & export
export.body: Every version renders live in the preview pane — click a version in the thread to show it, or edit text right in the preview. Export pages as HTML/PNG/PDF; animations render to a real H.264 MP4 at 1080p, 2K or 4K.
